---
name: "nf-core/fastq_align_bwaaln"
description: "Align FASTQ files against reference genome with the bwa aln short-read\
  \ aligner producing a sorted and indexed BAM files"
keywords:
- "bwa"
- "aln"
- "fasta"
- "bwa"
- "align"
- "map"
components:
- "bwa/aln"
- "bwa/sampe"
- "bwa/samse"
- "samtools/index"
input:
- ch_reads:
    description: "Structure: [ val(meta), path(fastq) ]\nOne or two FASTQ files for\
      \ single or paired end data respectively.\nNote: the subworkflow adds a new\
      \ meta ID `meta.id_index` that _must_\nbe used in `prefix` to ensure unique\
      \ file names. See the associated\nnextflow.config file.\n"
- ch_index:
    description: "Structure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\nA directory containing bwa\
      \ aln reference indices as from `bwa index`\nContains files ending in extensions\
      \ such as .amb, .ann, .bwt etc.\n"
output:
- bam:
    description: "Structure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\nSorted BAM/CRAM/SAM file\n\
      Note: the subworkflow adds a new meta ID `meta.id_index` that _must_\nbe used\
      \ in `prefix` to ensure unique file names. See the associated\nnextflow.config\
      \ file.\n"
- index:
    description: "Structure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\nBAM/CRAM/SAM samtools index\
      \ file (.bai, or .csi for larger references)\n"
authors:
- "@jfy133"
maintainers:
- "@jfy133"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bwa/aln@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwa/samse@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwa/sampe@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/samtools/index@0.0.0-1b655c6"
